name: Service status
description: Whether a service is currently available, from HSDS. Defunct is distinguished from temporarily closed because a resident needs to know whether coming back later is worth it, and inactive from both because a service can exist on paper while not being delivered.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Temporarily closed
hasDefinedTerm.description: Not currently delivered, but expected to resume.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Inactive
hasDefinedTerm.description: Exists but is not being delivered, with no stated resumption.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Defunct
hasDefinedTerm.description: Discontinued. Retained rather than deleted so that references to it keep resolving.
